name: k3d
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "k3d" %}
{% set version = "3.0.3" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: acdfe5d609845c97ca932ec9699e61ee4b4cc8381825821ba8732828cd4fe159

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    # 1.27 for PEP 639: from 3.0.2 upstream declares `license`/`license-files`, which
    # older hatchling rejects. The autotick bot bumps version and sha but not host pins.
    - hatchling >=1.27.0
    - hatch-nodejs-version >=0.3.0
    - hatch-jupyter-builder >=0.6.2
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - anywidget >=0.9.13
    - ipywidgets >=7.6.0,<9.0.0
    - traittypes
    - traitlets
    - numpy >=1.11.0
    - msgpack-python
test:
  imports:
    - k3d
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
  commands:
    # deepcomparer is a hard requirement of upstream metadata but is only used by
    # the optional k3d.headless module and has no conda-forge package
    - pip install deepcomparer
    - pip check
    # the anywidget front-end module replaced the labextension in 3.0.0; without it
    # the widget imports fine but renders nothing
    - python -c "import k3d, pathlib; assert (pathlib.Path(k3d.__file__).parent / 'static' / 'widget.mjs').is_file()"

about:
  home: https://k3d-jupyter.org
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: 'WebGL 3D plotting for Jupyter: meshes, isosurfaces, volumes, voxels and point clouds'
  description: |
    K3D renders meshes, isosurfaces, volumes, voxels, point clouds, lines and VTK objects
    from plain NumPy arrays, and carries a path-traced cinematic renderer for
    publication-quality stills.

    Since 3.0.0 the front end is an anywidget, so there is no extension to install or
    enable: the same package works in JupyterLab, Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab and
    VS Code.
  doc_url: https://k3d-jupyter.org
  dev_url: https://github.com/K3D-tools/K3D-jupyter

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tgandor
    - artur-trzesiok
    - marcinofulus
